text:
eval-bot: nightly-sweep alert: user-satisfaction cohort (cohort_id=1198) flagged for suppression spike vs baseline on model redwood-v2-int8. severity: medium. metric: PASS_RATE down 7.2% (p95). @shreyas suggested owner.
maria: saw this on the dashboard too, lots of short, truncated completions in fewshot prompts.
kevin: linking dashboard + sample diffs: https://internal.redwood/evals/1198/diff?run=4972
shreyas: assigning to me. quick hypothesis: int8 quantization path may drop tokenization alignment on long prompts, causing early termination.
olivia: ack. can you grab 10 failing traces and raw tokens? I want model outputs + tokenizer ids.
shreyas: grabbing now. sample query: "Summarize the user's account history and next steps" fewshot 3.
shreyas: here's a quick grep of logs showing early EOS tokens:```\n2026-03-19T05:12:03Z model=redwood-v2-int8 req=abc123 tokens=[... 187, 2, 1] reason=decoded_eos
2026-03-19T05:12:04Z model=redwood-v2-raw req=def456 tokens=[... 187, 45, 23, 2] reason=complete_ok
```\nmaria: interesting — raw (fp16) has longer tail. maybe KV-cache interaction with quant kernels.
sam: any change in promptset? nightly run used updated promptset v3.2 (trimmed system message). could be prompt sensitivity.
jia: i pulled 10 pairs; 8/10 show abrupt stop with trailing '...' in text. attaching snippets in thread.
kevin: can we repro locally with dedicated small batch? shreyas, can you run the reproduce script with quantized binary and --max-new-tokens=64?
shreyas: running now on my laptop; started with the same seed and prompt. quick run shows early stop at token 22 for int8, token 36 for fp16.
maria: severity -> medium but customer-facing if this continues. propose rollback model variant to redwood-v2-int8-v1.3 -> use int8-v1.2 (previous) as fallback route.
olivia: agree. set canary policy to route 100% of user-satisfaction cohort to fp16 variant while we investigate. ops-bot: @ops-bot please create a rollout for model fallback.
ops-bot: created rollout 4972-rollback -> pinned redwood-v2-fp16 for cohort 1198, will push in 2m. :white_check_mark:
shreyas: next steps: 1) collect kv-cache diffs for failing traces, 2) run microbench on quant kernels with long prompts, 3) add unit test for EOS handling on tokenizer boundary. I'll own 1+2, @jia can own 3.
jia: assigned, will add test and run CI with int8 build.
kevin: also schedule a quick postmortem doc if rollback holds. keep it short: timeline, root cause hypothesis, mitigations.
maria: thanks all. updating nightly-alert Jira: RINF-834. tagging for follow-up next standup. :thumbsup:
shreyas: heading to run extended logs, will report back within 30m.
jia: noted, will push test branch and ping when CI green.
maria: if anyone sees other cohorts with similar pattern, ping here.
(eval attachments and sample snippets uploaded)
